footnote_text: Represents 3,750 Ordinary Shares issued to the Reporting Person upon the vesting, on July 1, 2026, of the first of four equal annual installments of 15,000 restricted share units ("RSUs") originally granted to the Reporting Person on June 30, 2025, as reported on the Reporting Person's Form 3. The remaining unvested portion (11,250 RSUs) continues to vest in three equal annual installments on July 1, 2027, July 1, 2028 and July 1, 2029, subject to the Reporting Person's continued service to the Issuer.
